scope: Shared-TPG coordination and control module comparison; NOT an end-to-end independent planner benchmark or original-author reproduction
high_control: Event-only per-agent categorical bids mapped to an admissible priority permutation for MAPPO/IPPO; learned joint graph permutation for proposed and ablation. All can realize every admissible ordering; ties use common measured rule.
actor_information: Own six-frame measured history and current full team measured nodes/pairs; all agents allowed same team packet. No simulator navigation truth.
critic_information: MAPPO and proposed pool measured histories across agents; IPPO uses own history plus the SAME current team packet as its actor. This is communication-enabled IPPO adaptation, not strictly isolated-agent IPPO.
low_control: Same nine measured residual/hold/retreat candidates, validity masks, nominal prior and joint projection as EXP0053; per-agent PPO ratios rather than product of agent ratios.
innovation_hypothesis: Feed learned candidate-conditioned next measured velocity into policy scoring, alongside joint graph event priority. No-ac zeroes this feature and its auxiliary loss. Hypothesis is unproven; common algorithm fixes are not novelty.
shared_mechanics: Same measured assignment, hand-written event triggers, local TPG reservations, observer, physical control rate, independent scorer and EXP0053 rewards for all module-comparison arms.
preflight_identity: Every deterministic untrained network must match rule initial and final hashes on the two full preflight scenes, and policy updates must change intended parameters with finite gradients.
selection: All three seeds, all failed attempts, both preregistered checkpoints. Final 32768 primary development checkpoint, 8192 diagnostic only; no best checkpoint or seed promotion. New algorithm source edits require a new preserved study directory. Confirmation pools stay unopened.
budget_note: 32768 is a declared development budget, not convergence or equal best-tuned performance. No MAT implementation or hardware validation is claimed.
magnetic_caveat: 2 mm is unchanged, uncalibrated simulation spatial proxy; no real magnetic independence or absolute safety guarantee.
